audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit QuditCircuit performs the qutrit circuit evolution and all energy and string-order expectations. NumPy and JAX construct gates and provide differentiation; Optax supplies Adam. No other quantum framework is imported or used.
audit.cheating_rationale: The source computes results from the optimized variational state without hardcoded answers, hidden references, evaluator manipulation, or prohibited file access.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The implementation prepares the specified Neel state, implements the prescribed rotations and even/odd entanglers, and includes every open-chain Hamiltonian term exactly once. Combining each even-bond gate with its two preceding rotations preserves the specified circuit. It uses configured Gaussian initialization and exactly max_steps Adam updates, records pre-update energies, and evaluates final energy and the three required string correlators after the last update. Returned keys and NumPy quantities match the interface.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation error is present. Spin operators, gate generators, parameter counts, energy normalization, string parity factors, and optimizer timing agree with the specification.
